messages:
pagerduty-bot: Pager triggered: p99 latency on /v1/completions (chat) exceeded 1200ms for 5m on prod-eu. Notify: @elen (oncall), @jamie (sre)
elen (oncall): I'm on it. seeing p50 ~220ms, p95 ~480ms, p99 ~1.4s for route /v1/completions (model=mistral-1). customer complaints of slow responses.
jamie (sre): Confirmed. Spike started ~1778881180. Traffic higher than usual but not huge. Wondering if KV cache thrashing or a model change pushed to pool.
maria (eng-platform): No deploy around that time from our CI. Auto-scaler reports increased queue length on dedicated pool gpud-01-eu. Could be hotspot on mistral-1 shard.
sam (observability): Adding traces to the thread: see trace sample for request id 2a9f... latency breakdown shows decode time up on token 1..n. Might be kernel contention on 80k-batch CPU -> GPU copy waits.
elen (oncall): Live mitigation: 1) Squash alert to avoid cascade (squelch p99 alerts for this route for 10m) 2) Route small fraction of traffic to fallback model redwood-compat to reduce pressure 3) Scale up gpud-01-eu by +2 nodes (provisioning now). I'll execute steps.
pagerduty-bot: Squelch applied by elen for 10m.
jamie (sre): +1 on fallback routing. Can you add a temporary routing rule? Something like: if route==/v1/completions and model==mistral-1 then weight 0.8 else other models weight 0.2.
maria (eng-platform): Pushed hotfix routing rule:
```yaml
route: /v1/completions
conditions:
  - model: mistral-1
actions:
  - set_weights:
      mistral-1: 0.75
      redwood-compat: 0.25
```
Scaling started, ETA ~3m.
sam (observability): Created temporary chart on dashboards.prod > /v1/completions > per-model latency. Sharing link: https://dashboards.prod/r/abcd1234 (watching p95/p99 by model).
elen (oncall): Scaling completed, routing change active. p99 down to ~580ms after ~90s. p95 back to ~420ms.
jamie (sre): Nice, looks stable. Recommend keeping squelch for 15m from now and then re-evaluate. Also open a post-incident task to tune alerts and add per-model thresholds.
elen (oncall): Agree. Handing off to @maria for follow-up since this touches routing and autoscale config. @maria you take? I'm going off-call in 20m.
maria (eng-platform): Taking. Thanks @elen. I'll sketch follow-ups now.
rca-bot: Incident summary added: incident-1778881234. Severity: SEV3. Impact: Elevated latency on completions route affecting ~6% of requests (visible slowdowns but low error rate). Mitigations: routing weight shift + scale out + 15m alert squelch.
jamie (sre): Follow-ups (short list):
- Add per-model p95/p99 alert thresholds (mistral-1 heavier than smaller models)
- Add routing heatmap to console for first-level triage
- Add automatic short squelch when known capacity events occur (e.g., autoscaler scale-up in flight)
- Re-evaluate existing p99 threshold 1200ms (maybe tier per-route/model)
- Run load test on mistral-1 pool to reproduce age-related KV thrash

maria (eng-platform): Drafting alert rule changes. Proposal: set model-specific p95/p99 thresholds and use composite alerts to reduce noise. Example alert (PromQL-like):
```promql
# per-model p99 latency over 5m
max by (model) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/completions\"}[5m])) by (le,model))) > on(model) (model_threshold_ms/1000)
```
And an alertconfig YAML example we can push to alerting repo:
```yaml
alerts:
  - name: completions_latency_p99_per_model
    eval_interval: 1m
    expr: per_model_p99_request_duration_seconds > label_replace(model_threshold_seconds, \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\")
    for: 5m
    runbook: >
      Check per-model latency heatmap. If one model is the only noisy model, consider routing weight shift and scale up pool.
```

maria (eng-platform): Also proposing a new dashboard tile: "Model latency heatmap" with p50/p95/p99 over 15m buckets and a small table of active routes and model weights.
jamie (sre): One more thing: add a small rule to automatically squelch p99 alerts for a route for 10m if autoscaler is actively scaling that pool to avoid paging during expected transient lag. We should log and surface the squelch in the incident timeline.
elen (oncall): Good idea. For handoff notes: I'm off-call at 18:00 UTC. Current status: stable, no customer-facing alerts. Please escalate to me if p99 > 1s again.
maria (eng-platform): Will create follow-up tickets (labels: post-incident, alerts, routing). Tentative tasks:
- (P1) Add per-model p95/p99 thresholds and update alerting rules (owner: sam)
- (P2) Add model latency heatmap tile (owner: maria)
- (P3) Implement auto-squelch-on-scale (owner: jamie)
- (P3) Run load job + KV-cache profiling for mistral-1 (owner: eng-ml)

sam (observability): I'll own P1. I'll put together suggested thresholds; initial roughs: mistral-1 p95=500ms p99=1100ms, mistral-small p95=320ms p99=700ms, redwood-compat p95=250ms p99=500ms. We should derive these off 30d histograms before finalizing.
rca-bot: Follow-up tickets created: #INC-4012 #INC-4013 #INC-4014 #INC-4015.
maria (eng-platform): Great. I'll add the dashboard PR to the repo and ping for reviews. Thanks for the quick mitigation everyone.
elen (oncall): Thanks all — handing off. :wave:
jamie (sre): Good job team. Closing thread for active mitigation; leave thread open for postmortem notes.
rca-bot: Thread marked for post-incident review in 72h.
